Localization.Name: BUL-H4 Armor Stronghold
Localization.Description:
Item Type: Super Heavy Armor
Damage Reduction: 90%
Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C
Radiation Protection: 26800 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s
Carrying Capacity: 4.0 µSCU

Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.
